info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Investment Portfolio Withdraw-v4-spec
info.description: The Withdraw Portfolio API allows for the removal of specific investment portfolios from a user's account. This endpoint facilitates the deletion of portfolios that are no longer needed, ensuring that users can manage their investment assets effectively. Common use cases include financial management applications and platforms that allow users to adjust their investment strategies. By using this API, consumers can streamline their portfolio adjustments as part of their interactive investment experience.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to withdraw a specified amount of funds from their portfolio. Ensure that the withdrawal amount does not exceed the available balance. The operation is irreversible and is subject to the platform's withdrawal policies.

requestBody.description: The request body for withdrawing from a portfolio. This operation allows the user to specify the amount to withdraw and any necessary details relevant to the transaction.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRequest.description: A string representing the request body for the DELETE operation on portfolio withdrawals.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRespons.title: Portfolio Withdrawal Response

status.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the withdrawal request for tracking purposes.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the withdrawal operation.

state.description: Current state of the withdrawal operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the withdrawal operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Informational message related to the withdrawal operation.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRespons.description: Represents the response received after a successful withdrawal operation from the portfolio.
